dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Braves Blast Past Reds, Padres Outlast Nationals**

In a thrilling night of baseball, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Cincinnati Reds 8-3 behind a strong team effort. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Michael Harris II led the charge with key hits, while Dylan Lee turned in a dominant relief appearance, striking out three in a scoreless inning. 

Meanwhile, the San Diego Padres edged the Washington Nationals 7-5, with Curtis Mead and Jackson Merrill delivering big hits. Merrill's fifth homer of the season proved to be the difference-maker.

In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays pounded out 13 hits to defeat the Los Angeles Angels 8-5, with Yandy Díaz hitting two home runs. The New York Mets also came from behind to defeat the Miami Marlins 9-7, with MJ Melendez hitting a three-run homer.
